item.title: What’s happening with the America’s Cup?
item.description: With the America's Cup entry deadline extended to March 31, and the first race of the 2027 Match on July 10, the to-do list can't be too long. The Challenger Selection Series dates are not yet known, but as they started six weeks before the 2024 Match, that'd be late June... 17 months away. So what the heck is happening? The first episode of the official event podcast answers some of the questions, plus blog reports are getting posted from the early entrants: • Italy is ramping up in Cagliari. •

item.title: Entry deadline delayed for America’s Cup
item.description: The five teams entered in the 38th America's Cup have agreed to extend the late entry deadline, originally set for January 31, 2026. The new deadline is March 31, which may be sufficient for rumored efforts from Australia and Italy, along with the previously announced Riptide Racing from the USA. Riptide Racing founder Chris Poole set a fundraising goal of $50 million dollars for the challenge, with $30 million needed to meet the entry deadline.
